1935, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 307 Page 308
Blank Page
Feb. 19 Edw'd McQuillan - 14 - abcesses of lung - coming along O.K. (see Nov. 15 '34)
Blanch Mrs. Stoner - of Mansfield, O. broken back, has two small children she wants to live for ....
Leo Fitzpatrick - 47 - threatened cancer - has wife and 4 small ch. praying for his return from Ann Arbor.
Mrs. M. Gassman - 54 - "dying" ... 5 .... in St. Jos.
Marie Lubeck - 18mo. - double mastoid.
John Meunier - 7 - 1721 Junction Ave. - extremely near-sighted; wants to be a priest - specialist says only a miracle will cure him
Christopher de Mers - 74 - had fearful blood cancer (7 yrs. ago) cured completely - He promised to build a chapel in hon. of the SS. Heart if cured. His health is astonishingly good - hardly knows what it is to be tired ..
Anna Hook - 75 - prayed for last Wed. . . O.K.
Blank Page
Page 309 Page 310 Feb. George Burns - 48 - in Ann Arbor Hos. for observation - high-blood pressure.
Lawrence Burns - operation yesterday - lost leg - diabetis -
Mr. & Mrs. Jno. Chapp - young middle-age at the "parting point" ... Sacraments one away from Easter 4 yrs - the other other seldom .. ... W. A. Christman - presbiterian - 51 - threatened with loss of eye Raymond Lemanski - 35 - very serious stomach pains when he eats .... Rosencrest boy - 6 - pneumonia Mariel Zoe - 51 - ??? spine cancer? Baby Geo J. Bruce - 1 yr - fears double mastoids.
Page 311 Blank Page
